purpose: Describe conditional ordering in existing paired-model predictions without altering the frozen paired-versus-separately-fitted-host-only screen.
reason: Beating a separately selected/fitted host-only comparator does not logically demonstrate phage-dependent host ordering: additive f(host)+g(phage) scores can beat that comparator.

input_contract.samples: Full scored source universe of valid Sample metadata with unique row IDs and host/phage pairs and consistent genome-group mappings; no labels.
input_contract.paired_predictions: Nonempty mapping of block ID to exactly one valid model_id string and a nonempty row-ID-to-finite-numeric-score map. Every source row occurs in exactly one block; booleans and unknown/duplicate/missing rows are rejected.
input_contract.selected_feature_names_by_block: Exact same block keys; unique nonempty host:/phage: selected-feature names from authenticated paired-bundle manifests. Caller authenticates reports, manifests and implementation dependencies.
input_contract.provenance: The pure function does not itself authenticate model execution, partitions or score/artifact provenance.

definitions.selected_columns: Report host and phage selected-column counts separately for each block/model; counts alone do not establish conditional behavior.
definitions.host_pair: Canonical lexical host-ID pair drawn only from hosts observed in one block. Never pool the same pair across blocks, even if model IDs happen to match.
definitions.eligibility: At least two phages in the same block must each have observed scores for both hosts. Missing cells are never imputed; no-joint-phage and single-joint-phage pair counts/identities remain reported.
definitions.difference: For each common observed phage p, d(p)=float(score(first_host,p))-float(score(second_host,p)). Report contributing row IDs, d(p), minimum, maximum and max-minus-min range.
definitions.state_change: At least two exact order states observed for that eligible host pair within the block.
definitions.strict_reversal: Both -1 and +1 observed for that eligible host pair within the block.
definitions.coverage: Complete source row coverage required. Per block report eligible/possible canonical host pairs (null if no possible pair), unassessed pairs, and sum choose(common_phages,2) as a descriptive comparison count, never independent replicates.
definitions.numeric_behavior: No tolerance, smoothing, score normalization or significance threshold. Reject nonfinite derived differences/ranges rather than emit invalid JSON numbers; expose raw magnitudes including tiny floating-point effects.

interpretation_limits: Exact ordering changes/reversals describe recorded predictions on the observed grid only; tiny changes can be numerical effects.
Difference variation without a reversal need not change host ordering. Do not infer global score non-additivity, prediction accuracy, biological interaction or mechanism from these diagnostics.
No observed change cannot establish global additivity or absence of conditional behavior elsewhere.
Feature counts and paired-versus-host-only performance do not by themselves prove phage-dependent ordering.
